name: Claude Code Container
description: Claude Code Container 1.0.28 runs Anthropic Claude Code in a browser terminal and an MCP API.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Auth password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  claude:
    image: ghcr.io/worph/claude-code-container:1.0.28@sha256:a73863d23af0222037a0d51cef0c350bfd86825f693cc9bbf889a6484aad2f94
    container_name: claude-code-app
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "20041:9090"
    environment:
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ""
      AUTH_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_AUTH_PASSWORD}
      MCP_ENABLED: "true"
      CLAUDE_SESSION_TTL: "1800"
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        if [ -z "$$AUTH_PASSWORD" ]; then
          echo "Replace AUTH_PASSWORD before start. An empty value opens the API, and the catalog value is public. This container mounts the Docker socket." >&2
          exit 1
        fi
        exec /init
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/workspace:/home/claude/workspace
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config:/home/claude/.claude
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
  caddy:
    image: caddy:2.11.7@sha256:5e5286cb37d44086d651a5363f05f43a692ce4d649d88fb1bd844579f45fa9e8
    container_name: claude-code-caddy
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - claude
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8080"
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
          - claude-code
    configs:
      - source: caddyfile
        target: /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
configs:
  caddyfile:
    content: |
      :8080 {
        handle /login* {
          reverse_proxy claude:9090
        }
        handle /logout {
          reverse_proxy claude:9090
        }
        handle {
          forward_auth claude:9090 {
            uri /auth
            @unauthorized status 401
            handle_response @unauthorized {
              redir * /login
            }
          }
          reverse_proxy claude:8080
        }
      }
